title: Acme Mutual claims: data platform
subtitle: Where the claims data lives and how reporting reads it.

verdict.text: One database for the application and a reporting lake, with scheduled SQL, in North Europe.

blocks.text: Reports read from a lake loaded by scheduled SQL from the application database. Personal data stays in the EU.

facts.scope: The data platform of the Acme Mutual claims platform

regions.name: North Europe
regions.why: EU residency, close to the insurer's data

costs.source: EXAMPLE price table saved 2026-11-02, not real prices

decisions.title: Platform
decisions.chosen: One database with scheduled SQL into a reporting lake
decisions.because: Monthly reports, one source of claims, no streaming need yet.

assumptions: The monthly reports are the whole reporting need for now.
